requirements.text: Proposals must be received by the City by 3:00 p.m. PT on September 17, 2024.
requirements.quote: PROPOSALS DUE – September 17, 2024 - 3:00 p.m. PT
requirements.section: Request for Proposals Enterprise Resource Planning Software and Implementation Services

requirements.text: Proposals must not be submitted by fax.
requirements.quote: Submittal of response by fax is not acceptable.
requirements.section: Request for Proposals Enterprise Resource Planning Software and Implementation Services

requirements.text: The vendor must offer ERP software and services that satisfy all of the City's functional and technical requirements.
requirements.quote: provide ERP software and services that satisfies all of the City's functional and technical requirements

requirements.text: The preferred vendor has experience successfully implementing the proposed solutions for cities of similar size and scope of services.
requirements.quote: The preferred Vendor shall have experience in successfully implementing the proposed solutions for cities of similar size and scope of services.

requirements.text: Any best-of-breed Human Capital Management solution offered must be able to integrate with the selected ERP system.
requirements.quote: It is important that these solutions have the ability to integrate with the selected ERP system.

requirements.text: A vendor responding with a best-of-breed solution must complete the Section 6 Requirements template for the relevant functionality and submit it per the Section 5 instructions.
requirements.quote: To submit a response for one of the best of breed solutions, complete the Requirements template in Section 6 for the relevant functionality and submit per the instructions contained in Section 5 of this RFP.

requirements.text: The vendor must provide an integrated ERP solution that includes the modules and functionality defined in the Requirements document.
requirements.quote: The City intends to purchase an integrated ERP solution that includes the modules and functionality defined in the Requirements document provided with this RFP.
requirements.section: SECTION 3 - SCOPE OF WORK AND TIMELINE

requirements.text: The replacement ERP solution is to be implemented in phases or as recommended by the selected vendor and approved by the City.
requirements.quote: The City expects to implement a replacement ERP solution using a phased approach or as recommended by the selected Vendor and approved by the City.
requirements.section: SECTION 3 - SCOPE OF WORK AND TIMELINE

requirements.text: Vendors invited to demonstrate their product should be prepared to discuss the application's best practices and its ability to adapt to user preferences.
requirements.quote: Vendors who are invited to demonstrate their product should be prepared to discuss the application's best practices, and the system's ability to adapt to user preferences.
requirements.section: SECTION 3 - SCOPE OF WORK AND TIMELINE

requirements.text: The City's estimated implementation window runs from March 2025 through January 2027.
requirements.quote: March 2025-January 2027

requirements.text: All modules in scope must go live by January 1, 2027.
requirements.quote: Go Live for all modules in scope byJanuary1,2027

requirements.text: Finalist vendors must follow the City's pre-defined script during their software demonstrations.
requirements.quote: All Vendors must follow this script during their demo process.

requirements.text: The proposal must be one electronic PDF copy, in the order defined in the response format table, not exceeding 100 total pages excluding sample contracts.
requirements.quote: copy of your entire RFP proposal in the order defined in the table below that does not exceed 100 total pages (excluding sample contracts provided)

requirements.text: The response must include one completed copy of the Requirements document in MS Word format, with the Word format unmodified.
requirements.quote: In addition, provide the Requirements document in MS Word format.

requirements.text: Proposals should be emailed to the City contact at Thuch.Mam@FederalWayWA.gov.
requirements.quote: Proposals should be emailed to: Thuch.Mam@FederalWayWA.gov.

requirements.text: All data, materials and documentation originated and prepared for the City under this solicitation belong to the City.
requirements.quote: Ownership of all data, materials, and documentation originated and prepared for the City pursuant to this solicitation will belong to the City.

requirements.text: Vendor questions about the RFP may be submitted by email to the City contact by August 28, 2024, 3:00 p.m. PT.
requirements.quote: Questions regarding this RFP may be submitted to the City via email at thuch.mam@federalwaywa.gov by the due date outlined in Section 3 of this RFP.

requirements.text: Vendor responses should include the sections outlined in the Proposal Response Format; deviation may lead to the response being deemed non-responsive and disqualified.
requirements.quote: Vendor responses should include the sections outlined below.

requirements.text: Marketing literature should not be included in the proposal.
requirements.quote: Marketing literature should not be included in your proposal.

requirements.text: The proposal must begin with a cover letter that is an executive summary of the proposed software and services, limited to two pages.
requirements.quote: Limit to two pages.

requirements.text: The vendor must complete the Pricing Summary from Exhibit A, indicating costs for software and implementation services.
requirements.quote: Complete Pricing Summary from Exhibit A of this RFP.

requirements.text: Pricing must be comprehensive, including all taxes and available discounts.
requirements.quote:
Pricing should be comprehensive
including all taxes and available discounts.

requirements.text: Pricing must remain valid for 180 days from the response date.
requirements.quote:
Pricing must be valid for 180 days
from response date.

requirements.text: The vendor must price the software for the user counts defined in the RFP.
requirements.quote: Software: Cost of software for the user counts defined in this RFP.

requirements.text: The vendor must provide a separate pricing sheet for each deployment option offered (SaaS or on-premises).
requirements.quote: Provide a separate pricing sheet for each deployment option.

requirements.text: Implementation pricing must include all costs required for go-live, including software deployment, data conversion, system configuration, report development, testing and training.
requirements.quote:
Implementation Services: Include all costs required for go live including but
not limited to software deployment, data conversion, system configuration,
report development, testing, and training.

requirements.text: The vendor must price ongoing license and maintenance for Years 1-10.
requirements.quote: License/Maintenance: Include cost of ongoing maintenance for Years 1-10.

requirements.text: Financials software must be priced for 130 named users and 85 concurrent users.
requirements.quote: Financials:  130 named users,  85 concurrent users

requirements.text: Human Capital Management software must be priced for 400 FTEs and 744 W2s.
requirements.quote: Human Capital Management: 400 FTEs, 744 W2s

requirements.text: The proposal must include an implementation overview covering methodology, sample project plan, City and vendor resources, process improvement, change management, data conversion, testing, training and report development.
requirements.quote: Provide an overview of the implementation methodology including:

requirements.text: The proposal must include an overview of support services offered, including hours, response times, support tiers, post go-live services, backup and disaster recovery.
requirements.quote: Provide an overview of support services offered including:

requirements.text: The proposal must include a technology overview covering architecture and deployment options, data centers, hardware, mobile, remote access, integration tools and software updates.
requirements.quote: Provide an overview of the system technology including:

requirements.text: The proposal must include a security overview covering the security model, standards, SSO/SAML administration, multi-factor authentication and breach response.
requirements.quote: Provide an overview of the system security including:

requirements.text: The vendor must provide references from three current and two prior customers for the proposed software, using the Exhibit B forms.
requirements.quote:
Using the forms provided in Exhibit B provide references that include three
current and two prior customers for the proposed software.

requirements.text: Preference is for references from Washington State public sector clients.
requirements.quote:
Preference is for Washington
State Public Sector clients.

requirements.text: The vendor must disclose any contract terminations or legal actions with customers in the past five years, describing each situation with the contracting party's name and address.
requirements.quote:
Indicate if at any time during the past five years the Vendor has had a contract
terminated for convenience, non-performance, or any other reason, or has
entered into legal action with a customer.

requirements.text: The proposal must include sample contract documents such as a statement of work, license agreement, maintenance or support agreements and service level agreements.
requirements.quote: Provide sample contract documents that may include the following:

requirements.text: The vendor must document any exceptions it has to the RFP content.
requirements.quote: Document any exceptions you have to the RFP content.

requirements.text: The vendor's Requirements responses will be incorporated into the signed contract.
requirements.quote: will be incorporated into the signed contract

requirements.text: The vendor must provide a rating and a comment for every item in the Requirements document; blank responses may cause rejection.
requirements.quote: Vendors must provide a rating and a comment for every item

requirements.text: The vendor must not include hyperlinks in the Requirements document.
requirements.quote: Do not provide hyperlinks within the document.

requirements.text: The vendor must not modify the format, font or numbering of the Requirements section or insert page breaks.
requirements.quote: Do not modify the format, font, numbering, etc. of this section or insert page breaks.

requirements.text: Requirement comments must give a substantive explanation; generic comments such as "Standard Functionality" are unacceptable.
requirements.quote: A comment of "Standard Functionality" or similar does not provide us with the information required and is not considered acceptable.

requirements.text: Each line-item response in the Requirements document must be limited to 100 words.
requirements.quote: Limit each line-item response to 100 words.

requirements.text: The vendor must provide a certification of insurance before commencing any work.
requirements.quote: The City requires a certification of insurance prior to commencement of any work.

requirements.text: An underwriter's endorsement with additional insured verbiage is required, and the surety must be admitted in the State of Washington.
requirements.quote: An underwriter's endorsement is also required with additional insured verbiage and the surety must be an admitted surety in the State of Washington.

checklist.fact: The City of Federal Way (WA) is the issuer, seeking proposals from experienced, qualified Vendors that can provide ERP software and services meeting all of the City's functional and technical requirements.
checklist.quote: The City of Federal Way (City) is seeking to obtain proposals from experienced and qualified Vendors that can provide ERP software and services that satisfies all of the City's functional and technical requirements.

checklist.fact: The City intends to purchase an integrated ERP solution and to implement it as a replacement ERP, using a phased approach or one recommended by the selected Vendor and approved by the City.
checklist.quote: The City expects to implement a replacement ERP solution using a phased approach or as recommended by the selected Vendor and approved by the City.

checklist.fact: The City will also accept responses from vendors offering best-of-breed Human Capital Management solutions, which must be able to integrate with the selected ERP system.
checklist.quote: The City is also open to receiving responses to this RFP from Vendors that provide best of breed solutions for Human Capital Management to support the required functionality.

checklist.fact: Proposals are due September 17, 2024 at 3:00 p.m. PT, and late submissions will not be considered.
Vendor questions are due August 28, 2024 at 3:00 p.m. PT, with the RFP issued August 16, 2024.
The estimated timeline has implementation running from March 2025 to January 2027, after finalist selection in October 2024, demos in December 2024, and due diligence in January 2025.

Proposals are scored on Software (30), Technology (15), Vendor (15), Cost Value (15) and Implementation (25), and the Implementation criterion requires Go Live for all modules in scope by January 1, 2027.
checklist.quote: Go Live for all modules in scope byJanuary1,2027

checklist.fact: Pricing must be comprehensive (including all taxes and discounts), valid for 180 days, and cover software, implementation services, and license/maintenance for Years 1-10.
checklist.quote: Pricing must be valid for 180 days

checklist.fact: Proposals must be emailed as one PDF of no more than 100 pages (excluding sample contracts) plus the Requirements document in MS Word format.
checklist.quote: Proposals should not exceed 100 pages (a Vendor sample contract is not included in that limit).

checklist.fact: The pricing basis is 130 named users and 85 concurrent users for Financials, and 400 FTEs and 744 W2s for Human Capital Management.

The detailed modules and functionality are defined in a separate Requirements Word document that is not included in this PDF; vendors must rate each item, and missing many Required features may lead to elimination.
checklist.quote: The City intends to purchase an integrated ERP solution that includes the modules and functionality defined in the Requirements document provided with this RFP.

checklist.fact: The new ERP replaces Eden (financials, HR, time and attendance, payroll), Quadrant cashiering and Excel-based budget and ACFR, and must integrate with retained systems such as NeoGov, Power Time, Amanda and RecTrac.
